title: HB 237 (2011 Regular Session): Photo voter identification; require when a person appears to vote at registrar's office or polling place.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) Except as provided in subsection (6), each person who shall appear to vote in person at a polling place or the registrar's office shall be required to identify himself or herself to an election manager or the registrar by presenting current and valid government issued photo identification, before such person shall be allowed to vote.
(section) Sec. 1(2)
(quote) The identification required by subsection (1) of this section shall include, but not be limited to, the following: (a) A current and valid Mississippi driver's license; (b) A current and valid identification card containing a photograph of the elector issued by a branch, department, agency or entity of the State of Mississippi; (c) A current and valid United States passport;
(section) Sec. 1(6)
(quote) A person living and voting in a state-licensed care facility shall not be required to show a government issued photo identification before being allowed to vote.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1(3)
(quote) A person who appears to vote in person at a polling place and does not have identification as required by this section may vote by affidavit ballot. If, upon examination of the affidavit, the person is found to be a registered voter, the person's vote shall be counted.
(section) Sec. 1(4)
(quote) A person who does not have a government issued photo identification and who cannot afford such identification may obtain a state issued photo identification free of charge from the Mississippi Department of Public Safety.
(section) Sec. 1(6)
(quote) A person who has a religious objection to being photographed will be allowed to cast a provision ballot, and the voter, within five (5) days after the election, shall execute an affidavit in the appropriate circuit clerk's office affirming that the exemption applies.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 4 (23-15-631)(2)
(quote) The Secretary of State shall prepare instructions on how absent voters may comply with the identification requirements of the Help America Vote Act of 2002, which shall be provided to the registrar and enclosed with each absentee ballot.
(section) Sec. 6 (23-15-719)
(quote) The registrar shall identify the applicant by requiring him to present identification as required by Section 1 of House Bill No.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1(5): intimidating a voter by using the section is punished by fine of at least \$5,000 and/or 1-5 years
(other) Sec. 2: 23-15-11 amended (citizen of the United States, residency, qualified elector, entitled to vote on compliance with Sec. 1)
(other) Sec. 3-6: 23-15-541, 23-15-631, 23-15-639, 23-15-719 conformed
(other) Preclearance and effective date
